meta.git_describe: uncommitted working tree (multichannel bad-band recipe, P8 arm-lead investigation, iteration 'fixed6')

transmitter.board: 2x RadiANT-compatible USB stick (nRF52840), each running tools/ant_sim.py as a 6-channel ANT+ master - the two-master-boards, mixed-periods recipe that reproduces the arm-lead bad band on air (see the 'radiant-multichannel-bench-traps' memory note)
transmitter.profile: power, power-torque, power-torque-freq, telemetry, heart-rate, csc - 6 channels per master, 12 total

link.interference: arm-lead bad-band recipe: master 1 (devices 4001-4006) at roughly -31 dBm, master 2 (devices 4101-4106) at roughly -22 dBm - two master boards with mixed channel periods on the desk together, which the single-master recipe does not reproduce.

accounting.verdict: 6225 of it reported as RX_FAIL; the other 387 went missing without the radio noticing

notes: H2 (W5): this is the 2026-08-15 multichannel sitting referenced by the 'radiant-multichannel-bench-traps' and 'Package G bring-up' memory notes, archived from bench-logs/badband/verify_fixed6.json + health_before_fixed6.json + health_after_fixed6.json. single_channel=True (ant_ab.py's default) structurally excludes this run from the loss_exact/timing/acquisition gates, which is correct: those gates are about a two-backend A/B on one channel, and this sitting has neither an A/B pair nor one channel. loss_exact_pct is null (T6) because no channel's event counter satisfied ant_verify.py's exact-loss disqualifier at this loss level (16-36% wall-clock per channel, all radio-attributed: accounting.unaccounted=387 of 6612 missing, the rest are RX_FAIL). sched_missed is the one loss-shaped figure this note's own argument says the room cannot move: 5 (health_after.sched_missed=7 minus health_before.sched_missed=2). per_channel is verify.derived.per_channel, carried through unchanged - see it for the per-channel spread (16.25% to 35.90%) that no pooled figure shows. bench-logs/badband/ also holds prefix1, prefix2 and lrctrl1 runs from evidently the same sitting/investigation (each with its own verify+health trio); fixed6 was archived here as the fullest and most complete of the set (12 channels, the paired health-before/after, and the 'fixed6' name suggesting the final iteration of a fix sequence). The others are not archived by this commit and remain available in bench-logs/badband/ if a future session needs them.
